Visioner RT @NSTRIKE1231 : BIG | 🇫🇮 🇷🇺 ‼️ ‼️ FINLAND ACCUSES RUSSIAN HELICOPTER OF VIOLATING ITS AIRSPACE HOURS AFTER DRONE ATTACK ON RUSSIAN CARGO SHIP! Finland’s Defense Ministry says a Russian helicopter penetrated more than four kilometers into Finnish airspace, according to Le Monde. The incident occurred just hours after a Russian cargo vessel was reportedly attacked by drones in the Baltic Sea, adding to tensions surrounding the earlier maritime incident. 🔥 The timing raises concerns about a possible escalation in the Baltic region, although no direct connection between the helicopter’s movements and the reported drone strike has been established. An unauthorized Russian military flight into Finnish airspace also highlights the growing risk of dangerous incidents along NATO’s northeastern frontier. See the latest updates with us: @NSTRIKE1231 tweet

Visioner RT @NSTRIKE1231 : BIG | 🇺🇦 ⚔️ 🇷🇺 ‼️ ‼️ UKRAINIAN FORCES REPORTEDLY BEGIN CLEARING OPERATIONS IN DOBROPILLIA! Ukraine’s Armed Forces have reportedly launched clearing operations in Dobropillia, following earlier advances that saw Ukrainian troops recapture several positions in the eastern part of the settlement. The latest development suggests Ukrainian forces are attempting to expand their control and eliminate remaining Russian positions. The extent of the operation and the current status of the settlement remain independently unverified. 🔥 Clearing operations could mark an important step toward securing Dobropillia and reversing Russian territorial gains in the sector. However, the presence of remaining Russian forces means that full control cannot yet be assumed. Consolidating recovered positions and preventing counterattacks will be critical to sustaining Ukraine’s progress. See the latest updates with us: @NSTRIKE1231 tweet
